eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 9:59 AM on AUG 27, 2025 Effective until 5:59 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
The Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office has issued an evacuation order for zone S I S 1 4 0 5 in the Dillon Creek Ti-Bar Rd area. Anyone in this area is ordered to leave immediately.

For current information on this or any other emergency impacting Siskiyou County go to www.readysiskiyou.gov The Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office has issued an evacuation order for zone SIS-1405 in the Dillon Creek Ti-Bar Rd area. Anyone in the area is ordered to leave immediately.
